anima.name: Anima
anima.description: When I'm deployed or round start: choose 1 of 3 random Shinheuh to create in your hand. Round start: gain a Shinheuh combat slot.

silver-dwarf.name: Silver Dwarf
silver-dwarf.description: The first time you draw a card per round, choose the card directly from your deck instead of drawing randomly.

red-witch.name: Red Witch
red-witch.description: You can always see your opponent's hand and the top card of both players' decks.

hwayeomsa.name: Hwayeomsa
hwayeomsa.description: Spend 1: charge 1 Fire Charge and create Fire Core in your hand if you don't already have it.

jeonsulsa.name: Jeonsulsa
jeonsulsa.description: When I'm deployed, summon a 1 HP Conduit on the enemy backline if they don't already have one. When I use an ability, grant the conduit 1 HP.

irregular.name: Irregular
irregular.description: Slay: choose 1 of 2 random Outsider Powers that I don't already have and grant it to me.

living-ignition-weapon.name: Living Ignition Weapon
living-ignition-weapon.description: You may equip me as many times as you want with unique equipments. When you equip me, grant a random trait to a random ally that is not me.
